steps.en: Set up an old Python 3.5 + TensorFlow 1 environment with the pinned requirements
steps.zh: 搭老版 Python 3.5 + TF1 环境，装锁定依赖

steps.en: Pick the CSV, columns, window length, layers and epochs
steps.zh: 选好 CSV、列、窗口长度、网络层和训练轮数

steps.en: Cuts the series into fixed-length windows and rescales each one relative to its first value
steps.zh: 把序列切成定长窗口，每个窗口按首个值做相对缩放

steps.en: Builds the stacked LSTM described in the config, trains it and saves the model
steps.zh: 按配置搭出多层 LSTM，训练并保存模型

steps.en: Predicts multi-step sequences on the held-out data and plots them against the real series
steps.zh: 在留出的数据上做多步预测，并和真实序列画在一起

value.en: You watch windowing, normalisation and LSTM sequence prediction work end to end, in code short enough to read alongside the article
value.zh: 在一份能对照文章读完的短代码里，亲眼看到切窗、归一化和 LSTM 序列预测怎么跑通
